tasks.short: Obtain display items with other people

steps.what: Note products that could not be obtained

tasks.design: Missing products and display items are listed from {ERP}. Collaborating with others to obtain them stays a conversation. The list does not place an order by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Missing pieces were chased by phone with no shared list.
tasks.enabler_now: A stock row can show what the display still needs.
tasks.still_hard: Agreeing who will provide an item stays with people.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows a substitute that would spoil the display.
tasks.altitude: The gap is listed. Obtaining the item stays a conversation.

evidence.claim: A missing-item list is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a display is short of items and ends when the displayer notes what was not obtained.
An item has an id and a quantity on hand, produced by the stock record. A quantity that is not stored is not treated as available.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether display items are in the same stock record as products.
research_questions: Who is allowed to promise an item to a display?

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when stock is not recorded. Collaboration stays a conversation. The range is below that case.

tasks.short: Construct display components to the specifications

steps.what: Note glass or plastic that did not match

tasks.design: Specifications are opened from {DOCS}. Constructing or assembling displays from fabric, glass, paper, or plastic, with hand tools or woodworking tools, stays in the hands.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications were a drawing on the bench that got covered in offcuts.
tasks.enabler_now: The specification can be opened and kept visible.
tasks.still_hard: Cutting and assembling are physical, and the material may not match.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer feels a joint the drawing treats as simple.
tasks.altitude: The specification is visible. Construction stays in the hands.

evidence.claim: Opening a specification is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a component is to be built and ends when it is constructed.
A specification has an id and the materials, produced by the designer. A material that is not named is not assumed.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether specifications name fabric, glass, paper, and plastic.
research_questions: Who accepts a component that departs from the specification?

tasks.short: Discuss how a display plan will be implemented

steps.what: Discuss implementation with clients or supervisors

tasks.design: Plans are obtained from {DOCS}. Discussing implementation with clients or supervisors stays a conversation. Only what was agreed is written. The plan is not treated as already built.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans arrived as mail and the discussion had no single version.
tasks.enabler_now: The designer's plan can be opened as one document.
tasks.still_hard: Implementation is still discussed with the client.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows what the plan asks that the store cannot do.
tasks.altitude: The plan is the same one everyone sees. The discussion stays.

evidence.claim: Opening a plan is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a plan is issued and ends when the agreed implementation is written.
A plan has an id and a version, produced by the display designer. A point that was not agreed is not written as agreed.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether designers file plans where the displayer can open them.
research_questions: Who is the client for an in-store display versus a hired window?

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when plans arrive as mail. The discussion stays. The range is below that case.

tasks.short: Photograph displays and file them without names

steps.what: Open the display to be photographed
Take photographs of displays and signage
File the photograph against that display

tasks.design: The display id is opened from {DOCS}. Taking photographs of displays or signage stays with the displayer. The file stores the photograph against that display id. Faces are not named, and no image is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Photographs sat on a camera card with no link to the display.
tasks.enabler_now: A display id can be chosen before the photograph is filed.
tasks.still_hard: Taking the photograph, including the angle, stays the displayer's.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer frames out people who happen to be in the shop.
tasks.altitude: The photograph is filed on the display. Nobody is named from it.

evidence.claim: Filing a photograph against an id is a record. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a display is ready to record and ends when the photograph is filed on that display.
A display has an id, produced by the plan. The photograph is the file the displayer took. The store does not suggest a person's name.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether photographs may include staff or customers.
research_questions: Who may see a photograph of the shop floor?

already_counted.description: The hands-on time is already in the main step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when displays have no id. The photograph is still taken by the displayer. Faces are not named. The range is below that case.

role.altitude: Collaboration and construction stay in person. Plans are obtained and discussed. Photographs are taken by the displayer and filed against the display, with no face names.
reach: A colleague sees which products could not be obtained.
A photograph is filed against one display id.
skills_to_grow: Do not name a face in a photograph.
Do not treat a missing product as already obtained.
role.ambitious_version: The missing items are listed before the chase, and the display is still built by hand.
